Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you turn this into a clear prompt for a short handoff note to the orchard irrigation crew? the leak is at the junction beside the north block's third valve, near row 8. water has been pooling around the junction since yesterday afternoon, and the pressure reading on that lateral was lower than usual this morning. we haven't confirmed whether the valve itself is leaking or the connection just past it, so keep that uncertain and don't state a cause as fact. the crew can use the handwritten pressure reading and the location details here. do not open cloud links. ask for a brief note that identifies where the issue is, describes the pooling and the low reading, and says that the source still needs checking. keep it practical for a crew arriving to inspect the line, but don't write as if anyone has already repaired it. mention that the report came in yesterday afternoon and the reading was taken this morning. no need to suggest parts or a repair method, since we don't know what is wrong yet. just make the request easy to follow and don't turn the uncertain cause into a definite diagnosis.", "output": "Draft a brief, practical handoff note for the orchard irrigation crew about the reported leak. The issue is at the junction beside the north block’s third valve, near row 8. Water has been pooling around the junction since yesterday afternoon, and the pressure reading on that lateral was lower than usual this morning. The handwritten pressure reading and the location details provided here may be used. Please do not open cloud links.\n\nIdentify the location, describe the pooling and the low pressure reading, and note that the source still needs to be checked. It is not confirmed whether the valve itself is leaking or the connection just past it, so keep the cause uncertain rather than stating a diagnosis as fact. Mention that the report came in yesterday afternoon and the reading was taken this morning. Keep the note useful for a crew arriving to inspect the line, without implying that a repair has already been made. Do not suggest parts or a repair method, since the cause is not yet known."}]
